title: State Normalization
definition: Normalization is the process of flattening deeply nested JSON responses into relational dictionaries (using IDs as keys). This ensures data consistency (a user object only exists in one place in memory) and prevents excessive re-renders.
simpleExplanation: Instead of a User having an array of embedded Post objects, the User just has an array of Post IDs. You look up the actual Post data in a separate 'Posts' dictionary.
